auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
auth.locked: This account is temporarily locked after repeated failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or contact an administrator.
auth.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.

password.title: Change password
password.body: Choose a new password for your account.
password.forcedBody: You must change your temporary password before continuing.
password.forcedNotice: Your account is using a temporary password. The admin stays locked until you change it.
password.weak: The password does not meet every requirement.
password.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one.
password.temporaryHint: They will be asked to change it at their first sign-in.

common.reasonHint: Stored in the audit log with your name and the time (at least 3 characters).
common.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.

errors.validation: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.passwordChange: You must change your temporary password first.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notFound: This item does not exist or was deleted.
errors.customerPhone: This number belongs to a customer and cannot become a work phone. Use a different number.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbiddenBody: This page needs a permission your account doesn't have. Ask an administrator if you need it.
errors.loadFailedBody: We couldn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This item may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

numbers.ambiguous_separator: Use a point (.) or the Arabic decimal mark (٫) for fractions only — no thousands separators.
numbers.below_min: The value is below the minimum.
numbers.above_max: The value is above the maximum.

dashboard.body: Manage staff, their permissions and work phones from here.

section.staff: Create, edit and deactivate staff accounts, and reset passwords.
section.presets: Ready-made permission sets you assign to staff.
section.workPhones: Register or revoke delivery-agent and order-monitor phones.
section.orders: Follow orders and move them along, as your permissions allow.
section.currencies: Enable currencies and record exchange rates with their history.
section.cashAccounts: Cash boxes and bank accounts, their balances and transfers.
section.periods: Accounting periods, the close checklist and reopening.
section.ledger: Trial balance and entries by account and document.
section.settings: Store data, business hours, timeouts and protection thresholds.

dashboard.comingBody: Orders, catalog, stock and accounting arrive with the next backend phases.
dashboard.noSections: Your current permissions don't open any sections yet.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Admin accounts with their presets and extra grants.
staff.newDescription: Creates an account with a temporary password that must be changed at first sign-in.
staff.search: Search by name, username or email
staff.extraCount: {count, plural, one {# extra grant} other {# extra grants}}

fields.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and . _ - , starting with a letter.
fields.name: Full name

staff.accessHint: Changes apply from their very next request — no new sign-in needed.
staff.accessUnavailable: Viewing presets needs the roles.manage permission, which your account doesn't have.
staff.presetsHint: A staff member can hold several presets.
staff.extraHint: Individual permissions on top of the chosen presets.
staff.accountHint: Deactivating or resetting the password ends all of their sessions at once.
staff.resetPasswordBody: Their sessions end, and they must change this temporary password when they sign in.
staff.passwordWeak: The temporary password does not meet every requirement.
staff.deactivateBody: They can no longer sign in, and every session ends immediately. You can reactivate them later.
staff.reactivateBody: They will be able to sign in again with their current access.

presets.title: Permission presets
presets.description: Ready-made permission sets assigned to staff. Built-in presets ship with the system and cannot be deleted.
presets.newDescription: Pick permissions by area, then assign the preset to staff.
presets.search: Search by preset name or description
presets.permissionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}

fields.name: Preset name
fields.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and . _ - , e.g. order_desk.

presets.permissionsHint: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions chosen yet.} one {# permission chosen.} other {# permissions chosen.}}
presets.deleteBody: Staff holding it lose its permissions immediately.

workPhones.title: Work phones
workPhones.description: Delivery-agent and order-monitor phones. The server assigns the phone's role when it signs in to the app or the store.
workPhones.registerHint: A number owned by a customer cannot be registered. Changes apply at once and end the phone's earlier sessions.
workPhones.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. 07701234567.
workPhones.revokeBody: {phone} stops working immediately; its app sessions end on their next request.

fields.name: Person's name
fields.nameHint: Shown on their profile and on the orders assigned to them.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Every order with status, search and dates. What you can change depends on your permissions and the order's state.
orders.invalidRange: The start date is after the end date, so the date range was ignored.
orders.utcNote: The date range is in UTC, as the server applies it today.

detail.noActions: There is nothing you can do on this order in its current state.

confirm.markReady: Mark this order ready for dispatch?
confirm.dispatch: Hand this order to the agent? The goods leave the warehouse into their custody.
confirm.cancelBody: The order is cancelled before dispatch and its stock reservation released. The reason is kept in the order timeline and audit log.

dispatchBlocked.noDelivery: Can't hand over: this order has no delivery.
dispatchBlocked.noAgent: Assign an agent first, then hand the order over.
dispatchBlocked.deliveryNotAssigned: The delivery is not in the “assigned” state, so it can't be handed over.

assign.title: Assign agent
assign.noAgents: No active delivery agents are registered.
assign.cannotList: Listing delivery agents needs the user-management permission (users.manage).

orders.conflict: This order changed before your action was saved — it is now “{status}”. The page has been refreshed to show what you can do now.
orders.conflictGeneric: This order changed before your action was saved, so the page has been refreshed. Check its current state.
orders.forbidden: The server refused this action: you no longer have the permission it needs. The page has been refreshed to show what you can do now.

financeSettings.title: Store settings
financeSettings.description: Store data, business hours, order timeouts and protection thresholds. Every save is recorded in the audit log with its old and new values.
financeSettings.autoCancelOff: Auto-cancel is off (the default): a late order is only alerted about, never cancelled.
financeSettings.fixErrors: Some fields are not valid. Fix them and save again — nothing was sent.
financeSettings.noChanges: There are no changes to save.

fields.acceptance_alert_timeout_minutes: Alert when an order is not accepted within
fields.auto_cancel_enabled: Automatically cancel orders that are not accepted

errors.number: Enter a valid number within the allowed range, without thousands separators.
errors.timezone: Unknown timezone. Use the IANA format, e.g. Asia/Baghdad.
errors.closesBeforeOpens: Closing time must be after opening time.
errors.warningNotBeforeTimeout: The warning must come before the cancellation.
errors.range: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.

thresholds.title: Unusual-change thresholds
thresholds.body: Any change above these percentages is shown for confirmation before it is saved.

history.title: Change history
history.needsAudit: Seeing the change history needs the audit-log permission (audit.view).

currencies.title: Currencies and exchange rates
currencies.description: The base currency is fixed. Rates are entered by hand and kept with their date and who set them; a rate of 1 is never assumed.
currencies.baseLocked: The base currency is locked: it cannot be disabled, or changed after the first movement. Used currencies are disabled, never deleted.
currencies.staleCurrent: The latest {code} rate is not from today (effective since {date}). Update it before using it for today's documents.
currencies.noForeign: No foreign currency is enabled to record a rate for.

history.title: Exchange-rate history
history.empty: No exchange rate has been recorded yet.

form.title: Record an exchange rate
form.notToday: The effective date is not today. Make sure that is intended.

errors.rateRequired: Enter the rate — no rate is ever assumed.
errors.ratePositive: The rate must be greater than zero.
errors.rateDecimals: The rate allows at most 10 decimals.
errors.effective: Enter the effective date and time.
errors.reason: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.

cashAccounts.title: Cash and bank accounts
cashAccounts.description: Balances come from the ledger. A transfer is a numbered document, posted exactly once.
cashAccounts.empty: No cash or bank accounts yet.
cashAccounts.deleteBody: An account can be deleted only if it has no movements; a used account is deactivated instead.
cashAccounts.openingBody: One opening-balance document per account, posted to the ledger on its date.
cashAccounts.backdateHint: Only for a date older than the back-dating window; needs permission.

errors.name: At least 2 characters.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.precision: This currency allows at most {precision} decimals.
errors.to: Choose the account to transfer to.
errors.reason: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer.needTwo: A transfer needs at least two active accounts.
transfer.fixAndReview: Change the details, then review the transfer again.

posting.checking: The answer was lost. Checking with the server whether the document was posted before trying anything else…
posting.notPosted: Confirmed: the document was not posted. You can retry safely — no duplicate will be created.
posting.processing: The server is still processing this document.
posting.periodClosed: The accounting period for this date is closed, so the server refused to post. Choose a date in an open period, or ask for the period to be reopened.

periods.title: Periods and monthly close
periods.description: Closing is manual, after review. Afterwards the server refuses any posting dated inside the period; reopening is an exception with a recorded reason.

checklist.title: Close checklist
checklist.needsPermission: The close checklist and closing need the period-close permission (period.close).
checklist.blocked: The period can't be closed until the failing items are resolved.

periods.future: This period has not ended yet.
periods.closedBody: Closed since {at}. Any posting dated inside it is refused.
periods.reopenBody: Reopening is an exception: it is recorded with your reason, the previous close is kept for reference, and the differences are shown at re-close.

differences.title: Differences at close #{sequence}
differences.none: No differences from the previous close.

history.title: Close history
history.empty: This period has never been closed.

ledger.title: Trial balance
ledger.description: Account balances in the base currency as of a date. Read-only.
ledger.entriesDescription: Entries by account, document or date. A posted entry is never edited; it is corrected by a reversal.
